open.title: Task page in shadcn
open.detail: A shadcn mapping lowers the task page's HTML syntax tree to TSX using shadcn components, printed and parsed back, and the server renders it to HTML with Tailwind. renderTasks does not change.
open.done: the owner keeps the shadcn task page open instead of the plain one, and renderTasks is unchanged.

done.title: Gooi tracks itself (CLI)
done.detail: The operations `status`, `open` and `close --used "<what it was used for>"` are edges over `.gooi/slices.json`, with a generic CLI surface (`surfaces/cli`). The CLI keeps this page's Open slice and Done sections in sync.
done.done: the owner closes this slice with `bun gooi close --used "..."`.
done.used: to check the status of the project

done.title: Tasks as markdown files
done.detail: Each task is tasks/<name>.md with a status and created header and free notes below. List, add and finish tasks through the same generic CLI, and editing a file by hand stays valid.
done.done: the owner tracks gooi's real next tasks in tasks/ and has finished one with the CLI.
done.used: my agent tracks gooi's next tasks and I follow along

done.title: Compile the gooi command into a Commander CLI
done.detail: Edges describe their inputs with JSON Schema. One step turns the edges into a command tree with chosen names and groups; a lowering edge emits a Commander program that calls the edges directly. The generated CLI replaces `bun gooi`.
done.done: the generated CLI replaces bun gooi for daily use by the owner and agents, and @gooi/cli is not in it.

done.title: See tasks in a browser
done.detail: The tasks app renders its listing to HTML through an HTML syntax tree, printed and parsed back. A compiled server runs the task list then render path on each request; titles are text, never markup.
done.done: the owner keeps the task page open while working and it shows current tasks, including hand edits and agent changes.
done.used: monitor the task list as it updates live
